note: Our gain on a position (distributions + NAV - invested) set against the company's bridge at our entry stake, by hand. Stake = invested / company equity value at entry; our share of a driver = invested x driver / entry equity, held to ten places; other = gain less the three shares, so the four parts are the gain exactly. Bridge A is fixture 19 case 1 in millions (equity 250,000,000 to 595,000,000: EBITDA growth 250,000,000, multiple expansion 65,000,000, debt paydown 30,000,000, total 345,000,000; revenue 120,000,000, margin 130,000,000). Case 1: invested 10,000,000 is a stake of 10 / 250 = 0.04; shares 0.04 x 250,000,000 = 10,000,000, 0.04 x 65,000,000 = 2,600,000 and 0.04 x 30,000,000 = 1,200,000 (13,800,000 = 0.04 x 345,000,000); gain 2,000,000 + 22,500,000 - 10,000,000 = 14,500,000, so other = 14,500,000 - 13,800,000 = 700,000; revenue 0.04 x 120,000,000 = 4,800,000 and margin 10,000,000 - 4,800,000 = 5,200,000. Case 2, the case the old rule (gain x driver / company total) blew up on: bridge C has equity 400,000,000 to 402,000,000, nearly flat: EBITDA growth (60 - 50) x 600 / 50 = 120,000,000, multiple expansion (630 - 600) - 120 = -90,000,000, debt paydown 200 - 228 = -28,000,000, total 2,000,000. Invested 40,000,000 is a stake of 0.1: shares 12,000,000, -9,000,000 and -2,800,000 (200,000 = 0.1 x 2,000,000); our mark is well up, gain 48,000,000 - 40,000,000 = 8,000,000, so other carries it: 8,000,000 - 200,000 = 7,800,000 (the old rule gave 480,000,000, -360,000,000 and -112,000,000). Case 3, shares that do not terminate: bridge B is fixture 19 case 2 in millions (equity 150,000,000 at entry; EBITDA growth 58,333,333.33333333333333333333, multiple expansion 21,666,666.66666666666666666667, debt paydown -10,000,000). Invested 7,000,000 is a stake of 7 / 150 = 0.04666...; shares 7 x 58,333,333.33... / 150 = 2,722,222.2222222222, 7 x 21,666,666.66... / 150 = 1,011,111.1111111111 and 7 x -10,000,000 / 150 = -466,666.6666666667 (half up at the tenth place), together 3,266,666.6666666666; gain 500,000 + 10,000,000 - 7,000,000 = 3,500,000, so other = 233,333.3333333334 and the four parts are 3,500,000 exactly. Case 4, a loss on a company that grew: bridge A at a stake of 5 / 250 = 0.02 gives 5,000,000, 1,300,000 and 600,000 (revenue 2,400,000, margin 2,600,000); gain 4,310,000 - 5,000,000 = -690,000, so other = -690,000 - 6,900,000 = -7,590,000. Case 5, a company total of exactly zero is no special case: bridge Z has equity 300,000,000 at both ends (EBITDA growth 50,000,000, multiple expansion -30,000,000, debt paydown -20,000,000); a stake of 30 / 300 = 0.1 gives 5,000,000, -3,000,000 and -2,000,000, which cancel, and other is the whole gain, 31,500,000 - 30,000,000 = 1,500,000. Cases 6 and 7: an entry equity value below zero (150,000,000 - 160,000,000) or of zero has no stake, so nothing is split and the reason is non_positive_entry_equity. Case 8: no invested capital means no gain and nothing to split (no_gain).
